title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 — EUR-Lex
snippet: Article 52 transparency obligations apply to providers of certain AI systems, including chatbots and systems generating synthetic content. Providers must ensure users are informed they are interacting with an AI system.

title: Article 52 - EU AI Act
snippet: Providers of AI systems intended to interact with natural persons shall design and develop those systems in such a way that natural persons are informed they are interacting with an AI system.

title: EU AI Act - European Commission
snippet: The EU AI Act introduces a risk-based approach to regulating AI. General-purpose SaaS vendors must comply with transparency requirements, while high-risk AI providers face more stringent conformity assessment procedures.
